coverage_notes: EXHAUSTIVE sweep across foundational and contemporary research on choice complexity, decision fatigue, and cognitive load in human-computer interaction and decision-making. Coverage includes: (1) SEMINAL LAWS: Hick-Hyman law (1952), Miller's Law (1956), Fitts' Law; (2) CORE BEHAVIORAL ECONOMICS: Kahneman/Tversky bounded rationality & heuristics, Barry Schwartz Paradox of Choice (book 2004), Iyengar/Lepper jam study (2000); (3) COGNITIVE SCIENCE: Sweller's cognitive load theory, Cowan's working memory refinements; (4) DECISION MAKING FRAMEWORKS: Simon's satisficing & bounded rationality, Thaler/Sunstein choice architecture; (5) HCI PRINCIPLES: Shneiderman direct manipulation, Nielsen's 10 usability heuristics, Pirolli information foraging & scent, Norman mental models; (6) INFORMATION DESIGN: Tufte's data visualization principles; (7) INTERFACE DESIGN SPECIFICS: Menu breadth-depth tradeoff research, grid vs list layouts, progressive disclosure patterns, visual saliency & complexity measurement; (8) CONTEMPORARY RESEARCH: Meta-analysis on choice overload (Scheibehenne/Greifeneder 2010), recent decision fatigue frameworks (Frontiers 2025), arXiv papers on sequential vs pairwise choice presentation (Das 2025); (9) RELATED PHENOMENA: Information overload, feature bloat (interface bloat), choice presentation bias, cognitive biases in UI design (confirmation, status quo). Deduplication applied across multiple URLs referencing same papers (e.g., Iyengar/Lepper). Tiers assigned per theory leaf rubric: T0 for meta-analyses & systematic reviews, T1 for peer-reviewed CHI/UIST/ACM/arXiv, T2 for textbooks and seminal books by canonical authors, T3 for high-quality practitioner essays and design resources. License notes reflect content accessibility (OA PDFs marked redistribute-ok, paywalled ACM/Springer marked reference-only, Wikipedia/general articles marked redistribute-ok). Total sources: 38 (comprehensive for exhaustive theory leaf).

sources.title: On the Rate of Gain of Information
sources.notes: Foundational paper establishing logarithmic relationship between reaction time and number of choice alternatives; experimental work with 10-choice paradigms and binary coding framework

sources.title: The Hick-Hyman Law: An Argument Against Complexity in User Interface Design
sources.notes: Practitioner essay applying Hick-Hyman law to UX design, cognitive load reduction through choice reduction

sources.title: Hick's Law for Choice Reaction Time: A Review
sources.notes: Comprehensive review of Hick's law research, reaction time findings, applicability to HCI design decisions

sources.title: The Magical Number Seven, Plus or Minus Two: Some Limits on Our Capacity for Processing Information
sources.notes: Seminal paper establishing ~7±2 limit on absolute judgment and short-term memory span; foundational to information processing theory

sources.title: The Magical Number 4 in Short-Term Memory: A Reconsideration of Mental Storage Capacity
sources.notes: Refined working memory capacity estimate to 3-5 items when controlling for rehearsal; addresses Miller critique

sources.title: When Choice is Demotivating: Can One Desire Too Much of a Good Thing?
sources.notes: Classic field experiment with 6 vs 24 jam display conditions; demonstrates choice paralysis and reduced satisfaction with increased options

sources.title: The Paradox of Choice: Why More Is Less
sources.notes: Seminal book by Barry Schwartz introducing paradox of choice concept; extends Schwartz's research on maximizers vs satisficers

sources.title: Maximizing Versus Satisficing: Happiness Is a Matter of Choice
sources.notes: Schwartz's research distinguishing maximizers from satisficers; correlation with regret, depression, reduced satisfaction

sources.title: Decision Fatigue and Ego Depletion Research
sources.notes: Foundation of decision fatigue concept from Roy Baumeister; resource depletion model of self-control

sources.title: An Integrative Review on Unveiling the Causes and Effects of Decision Fatigue to Develop a Multi-Domain Conceptual Framework
sources.notes: Recent systematic review synthesizing decision fatigue research across multiple domains; organizational and job-specific factors

sources.title: Decision Fatigue, Choosing for Others, and Self-Construal
sources.notes: Peer-reviewed research on decision fatigue mechanisms and factors modulating fatigue effects

sources.title: Cognitive Load Theory in Computing Education Research: A Review
sources.notes: ACM survey of Sweller's CLT applications; intrinsic, extraneous, germane load framework

sources.title: Judgment under Uncertainty: Heuristics and Biases
sources.notes: Foundational paper on systematic biases in judgment; heuristics and bounded rationality framework

sources.title: Prospect Theory: An Analysis of Decision Under Risk
sources.notes: Theory of choice under uncertainty; reference point effects, loss aversion; framing effects on decision outcomes

sources.title: Choice Architecture
sources.notes: Seminal framework for designing choice environments; libertarian paternalism approach to shaping decisions

sources.title: Nudge: Improving Decisions About Health, Wealth, and Happiness
sources.notes: Popular book introducing nudge theory and choice architecture to broad audience; practical applications to policy design

sources.title: Bounded Rationality (Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy)
sources.notes: Philosophical treatment of Simon's bounded rationality concept; contrast with classical rational choice theory

sources.title: Direct Manipulation: A Step Beyond Programming Languages
sources.notes: Shneiderman's foundational HCI principles: visibility, rapid reversibility, continuous representation

sources.title: Perspectives on 27 Years of Fitts' Law Research in HCI
sources.notes: Historical perspective on Fitts' law application to HCI; speed-accuracy tradeoff in target acquisition

sources.title: 10 Usability Heuristics for User Interface Design
sources.notes: Nielsen's seminal 1990/1994 heuristic evaluation framework; foundational to HCI usability assessment

sources.title: Information Foraging Theory
sources.notes: Theory of information seeking behavior; information scent concept for web navigation

sources.title: Using Information Scent to Model User Information Needs and Actions on the Web
sources.notes: CHI paper on information scent concept; how users evaluate navigation paths and choices

sources.title: Mental Models in HCI
sources.notes: Norman's foundational work on user mental models; alignment between design model and user model

sources.title: The Visual Display of Quantitative Information and Related Works
sources.notes: Seminal work on information design principles; data-ink ratio and simplicity for complexity

sources.title: Can There Ever Be Too Many Options? A Meta-Analytic Review of Choice Overload
sources.notes: Meta-analysis of 50 studies on choice overload; questions sufficiency conditions for overload effect

sources.title: Choice Overload: A Conceptual Review and Meta-Analysis
sources.notes: Comprehensive meta-analysis identifying moderating factors: choice set complexity, preference uncertainty, decision goal

sources.title: Breadth vs. Depth in Menu Design

sources.title: Hierarchical Menu Design: Breadth, Depth, and Task Complexity

sources.title: Pairwise Beats All-at-Once: Behavioral Gains from Sequential Choice Presentation

sources.title: Eternal Quest for the Best: Sequential (vs. Simultaneous) Option Presentation Undermines Choice Commitment

sources.title: Visual Complexity and Aesthetic Perception of Web Pages

sources.title: Understanding Visual Saliency in Mobile User Interfaces

sources.title: What Is Progressive Disclosure in UX? Definition, Examples & Best Practices

sources.title: Presentation Bias is Significant in Determining User Preference for Search Results
